import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
namespace CoeffNonePullback152
open MvPolynomial
universe u v
variable {τ : Type u}

theorem coordinateInjective (ν : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun d : τ →₀ ℕ ↦ d.optionElim ν) := by
  intro a b h
  ext j
  simpa using congrArg (fun e : Option τ →₀ ℕ ↦ e (some j)) h

noncomputable def slice {A : Type v} [Zero A]
    (P : (Option τ →₀ ℕ) →₀ A) (ν : ℕ) : (τ →₀ ℕ) →₀ A :=
  Finsupp.comapDomain (fun d ↦ d.optionElim ν) P (coordinateInjective ν).injOn

theorem slice_apply {A : Type v} [Zero A]
    (P : (Option τ →₀ ℕ) →₀ A) (ν : ℕ) (d : τ →₀ ℕ) :
    slice P ν d = P (d.optionElim ν) := rfl

theorem direct_coeff {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R]
    (P : MvPolynomial (Option τ) R) (ν : ℕ) :
    ((optionEquivLeft R τ P).coeff ν).coeff = slice P.coeff ν := by
  ext d
  exact optionEquivLeft_coeff_coeff R P ν d

#check @Finsupp.comapDomain
#check @MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_coeff_coeff
#print axioms coordinateInjective
#print axioms slice
#print axioms slice_apply
#print axioms direct_coeff
end CoeffNonePullback152
